dedupe_keys.name: annual load dataset of electric vehicle charging stations

description: Annual Load Dataset of Electric Vehicle Charging Stations is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Ziyu Xu. The charging load dataset are collected by a smart energy measurement system over a one-year period, with data recorded hourly from six Electric Vehicle Charging Stations (EVCSs) located in the city center of China. The data provides a full annual cycle of charging behaviors. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
